findings.text: non-blocking: the new proof call at reckon/checkout_trust.py:470 reads the real mount table whenever a test does not patch station_store.filesystem_type, so test_the_cache_resolves_under_the_runtime_root (:59), test_the_cache_follows_the_root_the_station_resolves (:66) and test_a_published_image_lands_under_the_runtime_root (:110) now pass only where pytest's tmp_path sits on a non-shared filesystem. Measured on this node: with --basetemp under /home (gpfs) and no code change, test_the_cache_resolves_under_the_runtime_root fails with StationStoreError "it sits on gpfs", so a run whose TMPDIR lands on shared storage fails for reasons unrelated to the code and reads as a regression. The three cases should patch filesystem_type to a local type the way the new case at :74 does.
